display_long_description:
Features：
（MR technology breaks through the dimension barrier）
Revolutionary! MR technology seamlessly blends virtual and reality, bringing the tower defense battlefield right into your surroundings!
（Combines tower defense and combat）
A perfect combination of strategic tower defense and real-time battles! Each game is the ultimate challenge of brain power and reaction.
（Hero-specific skills）
Multiple unique heroes, unleash their exclusive ultimate skills, making you an unbeatable god on the tower defense battlefield!
（Variety of levels, endless challenges）
Multi-mode level design, the enemy gets stronger the more you fight, so that every battle is full of unknown and hot blood!
（Extreme strategy, fast Level up）
Precise deployment, real-time adjustment of tactics, use your strategy to defeat the enemy, and build the strongest defense system.
（Great rewards and personalization）
You can unlock exclusive weapons, skills, and emotes to conquer the battlefield with both strength and style!

A brand-new tower defense strategy game experience!Join now! The fantasy war will immerse you in the true thrill of strategy and combat!
